g.text: Request from Caddy, a node or a local process

text.tspan: delete X-Orama-Proxy-Node unless the peer is on the overlay
verify X-Internal-Auth MAC (v1, v2, v3, skew 60 s);
if invalid delete every X-Internal-Auth-* header;
resolve the matched route's Policy once,
put it on the request context
status writer, traffic attribution, phase marks,
nosniff, DENY framing, HSTS behind TLS,
resolve client network, exempt overlay + local;
auth, chain, capability, relay, general buckets
ns-NAME host -> namespace proxy (or MainGateway route stays);
index gateway only: tenant function traffic
signed hop identity, JWT (Bearer, ?jwt= on WebSocket),
API key; Open and HandlerAuth routes pass without one
extend read and write deadline to 5 min
